# hostereo_instance (Resource)

A Hostereo VPS instance.

Instances are **deletion-protected by default** (a server-side flag, exposed read-only as `deletion_protection`). `terraform destroy` fails until protection is turned off in the Hostereo console (instance Overview → API delete protection). Deleting also needs an API key with the `instances:delete` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "root_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "hostereo_regions" "all" {}
data "hostereo_plans" "all" {}
data "hostereo_images" "tlv" {
  region_id = one([for r in data.hostereo_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.slug == "tlv-dc-1"])
}

locals {
  ubuntu = one([for i in data.hostereo_images.tlv.images : i.id if i.distribution == "Ubuntu 24.04"])
  plan   = one([for p in data.hostereo_plans.all.plans : p.id if p.name == "Basic"])
}

resource "hostereo_project" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

resource "hostereo_instance" "web" {
  name     = "web-1"
  region   = "tlv-dc-1"
  plan_id  = local.plan
  image_id = local.ubuntu

  # Write-only: sent once at creation, never stored in state (Terraform >= 1.11).
  password = var.root_password
  billing  = "postpaid"

  project_id  = hostereo_project.web.id
  power_state = "running"

  # Deletion protection is on for every new instance and can only be turned off
  # in the Hostereo console. Until then `terraform destroy` fails on purpose.
}

output "deletion_protection" {
  value = hostereo_instance.web.deletion_protection
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Hostname (letters, digits and hyphens, max 63). Changing it replaces the instance, since the API has no rename.
- `plan_id` (String) Plan UUID from `hostereo_plans`. Changing it resizes the instance in place (the VM is hard-restarted; disks never shrink).
- `region` (String) Region (datacenter) slug or name from `hostereo_regions`, e.g. `tlv-dc-1`. Changing it replaces the instance.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `app_fields` (Map of String) Install fields for the application (see `fields` in `hostereo_applications`). Changing them replaces the instance.
- `application_version_id` (String) Application version (`marketplace_version_id`) from `hostereo_applications`. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `billing` (String) `prepaid_monthly` (default, paid from balance) or `postpaid`. Only used when the instance is created; changing it later is ignored (a warning is shown).
- `image_id` (String) OS image UUID from `hostereo_images`. Exactly one of `image_id` or `application_version_id`. Changing it replaces the instance.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Root password (12–50 chars, upper, lower, digit and symbol). Required unless `ssh_key_ids` is set. **Write-only**: sent once at creation and never stored in Terraform state or plan (needs Terraform 1.11+). Changing it later does nothing.
- `power_state` (String) `running` or `stopped`. When set, Terraform starts or stops the instance to match.
- `project_id` (String) Project UUID (`hostereo_project`). Updated in place.
- `ssh_key_ids` (List of Number) Ids of SSH keys saved on your account. Required unless `password` is set. Only used when the instance is created; changing it later is ignored (a warning is shown).
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) Tag UUIDs (`hostereo_tag`), at most 25. Updated in place.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Read-only. Server-side protection against deletion, on by default for every instance. It can only be turned off in the Hostereo console (instance Overview → API delete protection); while it is on, `terraform destroy` fails.
- `disk_gb` (Number)
- `id` (String) Instance UUID.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the instance is locked (e.g. unpaid invoice).
- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `plan_name` (String)
- `region_id` (String) Region UUID.
- `status` (String) Platform status, e.g. `available`, `stopped`, `processing`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing instance by its UUID.
terraform import hostereo_instance.web 0f1cfd7e-3d47-4b0e-9a7c-2f5b1d8e4c11
```
